disposition_reason: Twenty-seven bottled mineral waters bought in Curitiba markets were analysed for aluminium, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, copper, iron, mercury, manganese, nickel, lead, antimony, selenium, zinc and other elements; Table 6 gives per-sample triplicate means.

study.design: Market survey of 27 bottled mineral waters (20 from Paraná, 1 São Paulo, 1 Minas Gerais, 2 France, 2 Italy, 1 Portugal)
study.origin: bottled in Brazil (Paraná, São Paulo, Minas Gerais) or imported from France, Italy and Portugal
study.method: Samples acidified to 1% HNO3; Al, Ba, Cd, Cr, Cu, Fe, Li, Mn, Ni, Sr, V, Zn by ICP OES; Hg by CVG-ICP OES; As, Pb, Sb, Se by ICP-MS
study.qa: AccuStandard QC materials QCS-01-5, QCS-02-R1-5 and TCLP-02-1 and spike recoveries within 90-111%, RSD < 10%
